description.value: The study investigated whether early language experience influences later neural processing during a French phonological working memory task using fMRI in French monolingual, Chinese–French bilingual, and internationally adopted children.

quotes: Using fMRI, we scanned the following three groups performing a French phonological working memory (PWM) task: (1) monolingual French children; (2) children adopted from China before age 3 who discontinued Chinese and spoke only French; (3) Chinese-speaking children who learned French as a second language but maintained Chinese.

description.value: Participants heard French pseudowords and responded with a button press to targets in 0-back, 1-back, and 2-back conditions.
